summary: OneMedNet filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff notice dated October 13, 2026, confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company had received a deficiency letter on April 14, 2026, with a grace period through October 12, 2026; the closing bid price stayed at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from September 29 through October 12, 2026, closing the matter. No advisor or board recommendation was named.
